subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers close/adopt the open conflicting fork PR or allow a narrow same-repo replacement fix for this Telegram approval cleanup?
rationale: The bug is narrow and source-reproducible, but the only open linked PR is a conflicting fork PR that targets the removed handler path, so automation should not create competing work without maintainer direction.

options.title: Replace the stale fork path
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR and allow a narrow same-repo fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with live Telegram proof.

options.title: Adopt the fork PR manually
options.body: A maintainer can retarget the fork PR, strip unrelated docs and old-handler changes, and turn it into the active-runtime fix.

options.title: Defer without new automation
options.body: Leave this issue open and keep `clawsweeper:no-new-fix-pr` until a maintainer is ready to sponsor the cleanup.

recommendation.title: Replace the stale fork path
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR and allow a narrow same-repo fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current behavior and owner seam come from the native approval lifecycle refactor authored and merged by gumadeiras.
